content: Wode wursisetha bolla issi issi asay ammano aggidi baleththiza ayanatanne iita ayana timirte kaallanayssa Xillo Ayanay qoncera yootees.
Hessa mala timirtey ista qofay bonqo biratan xuugetida mala geellatethan doccida qoodheppe qommon haniza wordancha asatappe yaana.
He asati asay ekkonta malanne gelonta mala diggana. Ammanizaytinne tuma shaakki eriza asay Xoossi medhdhida kath galatarakka ekkizayti moonta mala diggananne azazana.
Xoossi medhdhiday wurikka lo7o. Asi galatara ekkikko wora wodhdhizay issinaka baawa.
Hayssa ha azazoza ammaniza asa ne qofsikko, ammano qaalaninne ne ekkida lo7o timirtezan minnada Yesus Kirstoosas lo7o oosancha gidandassa.
Xoosse bonchisonta go7ay baynda hayssi7eppenne cima macasata hayssi7eppe haakkada tuma ayana oosos ne asateth giigissa.
Asatetha asho ogen dosisoy guutha wodes go7ees shin Tumu Ayana duussas bana tamarsoy gidikko hayssa ha alamezassinne buro yaana duussas hidotay diza gish ubbas go7ees.
Hayssi ha qaalay ammanettidayssanne wursi ekkanas bessiza qaala.
Nu hessas giidi dafettossinne daaburos. Hessika asa ubbas harappeka ammanizaytas ashshiza de7o Xoossan nu hidota ooththiza gishassa.
Ne yalagatetha oonikka leqqofo; gido attin ne haasayan, ne duussan, siiqon, ammanoninne geeshshatethan ammanizaytas lo7o leemiso gida.
Ta he baana gakkanaas qaala nababanas, zoranasinne tamarsanas minna.
Cimati ne bolla ba kushe woththi woossishin, nees imettida tinbite imotetha lepi hista aggofa.
Asi wuri ne dichchaa beyana mala ha yo7ota lo7etha minthada dandayan pola.
Ne duussa gishshinne ne tamarsiza timirtezas naageta, haytan minna. Ne hessa ooththikko nenanne ne gizayssa siyizayta ashshana.

footnotes.text: dafettossinne issi issi birsheta maxaafati “Baaxetoos” gishin issoti issoti “Cayettos” giidi birshida.
